y-m-57-03.title: Indawo yensimu yemifino lapho ubude bocingo bumisiwe
y-m-57-03.topic: Okuphezulu kakhulu komsebenzi we-quadratic nebanga elivunyelwe lento eguquguqukayo
y-m-57-03.goal: Hlola ngethebula ukuthi okuphezulu kakhulu kwendawo ebhalwe njengesisho se-quadratic kwenzeka kuphi, nquma wena ukuthi isikhundla sokuphezulu kakhulu singashintsha lapho isimo esisha sishintsha ibanga lento eguquguqukayo, bese wakha izixazululo ngaphakathi kwebanga wena.
y-m-57-03.material: Ufuna ukwenza insimu yemifino eyisikwele esinde usebenzisa uhlangothi olulodwa lodonga. Alukho ucingo ohlangothini lodonga, futhi usebenzisa wonke ucingo olungu-20 m ezinhlangothini ezintathu ezisele. Uma izinhlangothi ezimbili eziqonde ngqo kudonga ngasinye zinobude obungu-x m, khona uhlangothi oluhambisana nodonga lungu-(20−2x) m. Ngakho indawo yensimu ingu-x(20−2x) m², futhi lapha 0<x<10.
y-m-57-03.thinking.0: Bikezela lapho okuphezulu kakhulu kukhona usebenzisa ithebula
y-m-57-03.thinking.1: Vuselela isinqumo sakho ngokubonisa ukuthi isimo esisha sishintsha kanjani ibanga lento eguquguqukayo
y-m-57-03.thinking.2: Thola amanani anelisa izimo ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa

y-m-57-03.s.s1.prompt: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, bheka ulwazi olusha bese ukhetha isinqumo sakho ngo-x owenza indawo ibe nkulu kakhulu.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.hint.0: Faka x njengo-1, 2, 3, ... oyedwa ngesikhathi bese ubala indawo.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala isimo esisha njengokungalingani ku-x bese uqala unqume ibanga elingenzeka lika-x.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Njengoba x iba nkulu, izinhlangothi eziqonde ngqo kudonga ziba mude, kodwa uhlangothi oluhambisana nodonga, (20−2x), luba lufushane. Awukabali amanani.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Indawo ishintsha kanjani njengoba wenza x ibe nkulu kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-10?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Lapho uhlangothi olulodwa luba lude, olunye luba lufushane, ngakho awukwazi ukunquma ngomthelela wohlangothi olulodwa kuphela. 'b' isilinganiso futhi 'd' isinqumo sokuhlola ngethebula. Ake sihlole ngethebula.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ikhula ekuqaleni, bese iba ncane kusukela endaweni ethile
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Iba ncane ekuqaleni, bese ikhula futhi
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ubheka ithebula, wawunquma ini ngo-x onikeza indawo enkulu kakhulu?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ithebula linamanani alinganayo kwesobunxele nakwesokudla ka-5 (4 no-6 banikeza u-48, 3 no-7 banikeza u-42). Ngakho u-5 ungumuntu oqokelwayo omkhulu kakhulu. Uma uphinda ubhale isisho njengo-−2(x−5)²+50, ungaqinisekisa ukuthi noma kuma-x edesimali, u-50 ku-5 uphezulu kakhulu.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ngiphetha ngokuthi inkulu kakhulu lapho x=5 (phakathi kwamanani ezinombolo eziphelele ethebuleni, u-5 uphezulu kakhulu nawo)
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ngiphetha ngokuthi inkulu kakhulu lapho x=4
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ngiphetha ngokuthi inkulu kakhulu lapho x=6
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Iseduze no-x=5, kodwa kusenesikhathi sokusho ngokuqinisekile ngaphambi kokuhlola amanani edesimali
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ulwazi olusha: udonga lapho uzobeka khona le nsimu lungu-8 m kuphela ubude. Uhlangothi oluhambisana nodonga, (20−2x), alukwazi ukudlula u-8 m.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Manje, phakathi kwama-x angenzeka, wawunquma kanjani inani elinikeza indawo enkulu kakhulu?
y-m-57-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kusuka ku-20−2x≤8, x kumele ibe ngu-6 okungenani. Uma x=5, uhlangothi oluhambisanayo lungu-10 m, olude kunodonga, ngakho akunakwenzeka. Ku-x≥6, uma x inkulu, indawo incane, ngakho u-48 ku-x=6 uphezulu kakhulu. I-vertex yesisho (x=5) ingaba ngaphandle kwebanga elingenzeka.
y-m-57-03.s.s1.reflect: Lapho kuvela isimo esisha, akusikho ukuthi isinqumo sakho sangaphambilini (x=5) sasingalungile; 'ibanga elingenzeka lika-x' lashintsha, ngakho isikhundla sokuphezulu kakhulu singashintsha. Sho ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olushintshe isinqumo sakho, noma ukuthi ubungasishiya njengoba sinjalo yini.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi udonga lungu-8 m ubude, thola amanani ama-3 ahlukene ka-x lapho indawo ingu-46 m² noma ngaphezulu. (x ingaba yidesimali.)
y-m-57-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala unqume ibanga lika-x kusukela esimweni sodonga, bese uhlola amanani ngaphakathi kuphela.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.hint.1: Thola indawo ku-x=6, bese wenyusa x kancane kancane bese ubona ukuthi indawo ishintsha kanjani.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.ok.c1: x inkulu kuno-0 futhi incane kuno-10.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c1: x kumele ibe nkulu kuno-0 futhi ibe incane kuno-10.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Uhlangothi oluhambisana nodonga lungu-8 m noma ngaphansi.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Uhlangothi oluhambisana nodonga, (20−2x), luphezu kuka-8 m.
y-m-57-03.s.s2.explain: Kusuka esimweni sodonga, x≥6, futhi kusuka esimweni sendawo x(20−2x)≥46, x ingu-6.41 cishe noma ngaphansi. Ngakho amanani ngaphakathi kuka-6≤x≤6.41 yimpendulo. Ku-x=6.5 indawo ingu-45.5, okungasanelisi.

y-m-57-01.title: Ukuhambisana okune: yiziphi ezingemisebenzi?
y-m-57-01.topic: Incazelo yomsebenzi: ukuhambisana okunomphumela owodwa kokufakwayo ngakunye
y-m-57-01.goal: Hlulela ukuhambisana ngendinganiso 'umphumela owodwa kokufakwayo ngakunye', khombisa ngezibonelo ozakhele wena ukuthi okufakwayo okuhlukile kungaba nomphumela ofanayo futhi kube ngumsebenzi, bese usho indlela yokulungisa ukuhambisana okungewona umsebenzi ukuze kuthi kube ngumsebenzi.
y-m-57-01.material:
Uma kunokuhambisana (umthetho), sifuna ukubheka ukuthi kuphuma muphi umphumela kokufakwayo okukodwa. Kunokuhambisana okune ngezansi.
(가) Kumfundi ngamunye ekilasini, nikeza inombolo yokuba khona yalowo mfundi. (Izinombolo zokuba khona sezivele zinqunyiwe.)
(나) Enombolweni ephelele eyiphozithivu x, nikeza izihlukanisi eziphozithivu ze-x.
(다) Enombolweni ephelele x, nikeza isikwele sika-x.
(라) Enombolweni yangempela x okungenani engu-0, nikeza "inombolo yangempela y esikwele sayo silingana no-x."
y-m-57-01.thinking.0: Bhala yonke imiphumela kokufakwayo ngakunye ngaphansi komthetho wokuhambisana bese uhlulela
y-m-57-01.thinking.1: Yakha umsebenzi lapho okufakwayo okuhlukile kunomphumela ofanayo
y-m-57-01.thinking.2: Lungisa ukuhambisana okungewona umsebenzi ngokushintsha imibandela yawo ukuze kube ngumsebenzi
y-m-57-01.prereq.0: I-H2 ikhombisa kuphela izinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kwale nqwaba yokukhiqiza; akuyona indlela yokwabela ibanga lesikole. Cabanga ukuthi okuqukethwe kwezinga lesikole sesibili okungezansi sekufundiwe.
y-m-57-01.prereq.1: Incazelo yengxenye yesethi negama elithi ukuhambisana (izinga lesikole sesibili)
y-m-57-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha konke ukuhambisana okungemisebenzi. (Umsebenzi: ukuhambisana lapho, kunoma yiliphi inani elingaba okufakwayo, umphumela unqunywa ube munye ngqo.)
y-m-57-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kukuhambisana ngakunye, khetha okufakwayo okukodwa bese ubhala yonke imiphumela ephumayo.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kukuhambisana ngakunye, khetha okufakwayo okubili noma okuthathu bese wenza ithebula elithi "okufakwayo → umphumela", bese ufuna imigqa lapho okufakwayo kufana noma imiphumela ifana.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo sibale, elilodwa ngelilodwa, ukuthi okufakwayo ngakunye (umfundi) kunemiphumela (izinombolo) emingaki.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.o.b: (나) inombolo ephelele eyiphozithivu x → izihlukanisi eziphozithivu ze-x
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.b: Bala ukuthi kuphuma imiphumela emingaki kokufakwayo 6. Indinganiso ukuthi kukhona yini ngisho nokufakwayo okukodwa okunemiphumela eminingi.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sehlukanise ukuthi okufakwayo okuhlukile (isibonelo 2 no-−2) kuvunyelwe yini ukuba nomphumela ofanayo kwindinganiso yokuthi okufakwayo ngakunye kunemiphumela emingaki.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.o.d: (라) inombolo yangempela x engu-0 noma ngaphezulu → y esikwele sayo singu-x
y-m-57-01.s.s1.r.d: Kokufakwayo 4, bhala zonke izinombolo zangempela y ezinesikwele esingu-4. Indinganiso ukubala ukuthi zingaki.
y-m-57-01.s.s1.explain: Indinganiso yomsebenzi ithi 'okufakwayo okukodwa kunika umphumela owodwa kuphela?'. (가) ngumsebenzi ngoba umfundi ngamunye unenombolo eyodwa, futhi (다) ngumsebenzi ngoba inombolo ephelele ngayinye inesikwele esisodwa. Kulungile ukuthi 2 no-−2 bobabili banika u-4 ku-(다). (나) akuyona umsebenzi ngoba u-6 unika 1, 2, 3, 6, futhi (라) akuyona umsebenzi ngoba u-4 unika u-2 no-−2.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.prompt: Cabanga ngomsebenzi f onendawo {1, 2, 3} ne-codomain {1, 2, 3, 4}. Yenza imisebenzi emi-3 ehlukile ibanga layo linezingxenye ezi-2 ngqo. (p = f(1), q = f(2), r = f(3))
y-m-57-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi mangaki amapheya phakathi kwamanani amathathu f(1), f(2), f(3) okufanele alingane ukuthola izinhlobo ezimbili zamanani ezahlukile.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ukhethe okufakwayo okubili okuzoba nenani elifanayo, bese unikeza okufakwayo okusele inani elihlukile.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c1: f(1), f(2), f(3) kufanele ngalinye libe lilodwa lika-1, 2, 3, 4.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ungasebenzisa kuphela izingxenye ze-codomain. Amadesimali akekho ku-codomain.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Inani lamanani ahlukile aphumile lingu-2 ngqo.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Akukho manani ama-2 ahlukile. Hlola ukuthi amanani amathathu awafani wonke noma ahlukile wonke.
y-m-57-01.s.s2.explain: Ibanga elinezingxenye ezi-2 lisho ukuthi okufakwayo okubili kwezintathu kunomphumela ofanayo. Isibonelo, f(1)=f(2)=1, f(3)=2 nayo ingumsebenzi. Ikhona imisebenzi engu-36 sonke. Umsebenzi ungaba nokufakwayo okuhlukile okunomphumela ofanayo, kodwa okufakwayo okukodwa kunomphumela owodwa kuphela.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.prompt: Ungasilungisa kanjani isimiso sokuhambisana (라) ukuze sibe ngumsebenzi? Bhala umthetho olungisiwe nesizathu sokuthi ukuwulungisa ngaleyo ndlela kusebenza.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala konke ama-y afeza umbandela uma x=4.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi yimuphi umbandela ongawengeza ukugcina ilodwa kuphela kwalawo manani.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Emthethweni wakho olungisiwe, ingabe uzihlolele ukuthi okufakwayo okufana no-4 kunikeza umphumela owodwa kuphela?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe 'isizathu' sixhumene nokuthi mangaki amanani ahambisana no-4?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange ukuthi indlela ehlukile kweyakho (isibonelo, ukuvumela u-0 noma ngaphansi kuphela) nayo iyenzeka?
y-m-57-01.s.s3.model.0: Ngilungisa ukuze kuhambisaniswe kuphela u-y ongu-0 noma ngaphezulu (impande eyisikwele). Ekuqaleni, lapho x=4, y wayenamanani amabili, 2 no-−2, kodwa uma ngiyenqaba ibe ngu-0 noma ngaphezulu, kusala umphumela owodwa kuphela.
y-m-57-01.s.s3.model.1: Ngivumela kuphela amanani angeyona i-negethivu ka-y ukuze okufakwayo ngakunye kube nomphumela owodwa. Inkinga kwakuwukuthi kokubili 2 no-−2 kwaphuma ku-x=4.

y-m-57-02.title: Ukuhlola isitatimende esithi 'uma kunyukayo, i-slope inkulu'
y-m-57-02.goal: Yazi ukuthi 'okunyukayo' no-'i-slope enkulu' akusho njalo into efanayo, thola futhi ulungise umugqa ongalungile esimweni esiqhathanisa ama-slope anezimpawu ezihlukile, bese wakha isibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-57-02.material: Amagrafu emisebenzi emibili emaqondana y=2x no-y=−3x adwetshwe epulanini lezixhumanisi elifanayo. Igrafu ka-y=2x ikhuphukela ngakwesokudla, futhi igrafu ka-y=−3x yehlela ngakwesokudla. I-slope 'inguquko ka-y lapho x inyuka ngo-1'. Ngezansi kunesiqephu lapho umfundi aqhathanisa ama-slope amabili.
y-m-57-02.thinking.0: Thola iphutha ngokuhlukanisa imigqa yesixazululo ibe amaqiniso nokujwayelekisa
y-m-57-02.thinking.1: Yakha wena isibonelo esiphikisayo lapho ukujwayelekisa kuphuka
y-m-57-02.thinking.2: Sho izimo lapho ukujwayelekisa kubamba khona
y-m-57-02.prereq.1: Incazelo yokuthi emsebenzini omaqondana y=ax+b, inguquko ka-y lapho x inyuka ngo-1 yi-slope a
y-m-57-02.prereq.2: Ukuqhathanisa usayizi wezinombolo eziphozithivu nezingu-negethivu emgqeni wezinombolo
y-m-57-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala kulesi siqephu oqukethe isimangalo esingalungile. (Imigqa elandela lowo mangalo nayo ingaba ngalungile.)
y-m-57-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlunga umugqa ngamunye ube 'iqiniso elifundwe kugrafu noma esibalweni' noma 'isimangalo esenziwe emthethweni'.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.hint.1: Beka u-−3 no-2 emgqeni wezinombolo bese uqhathanisa ukuthi iyiphi esekude ngakwesokudla nokunyuka kwegrafu ngayinye.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.0: Ku-y=2x, lapho x inyuka ngo-1, y inyuka ngo-2.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.1: Ku-y=−3x, lapho x inyuka ngo-1, y yehla ngo-3.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.2: Igrafu enyuka kakhulu inayo i-slope enkulu.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.line.3: Igrafu ka-y=−3x inyuka kakhulu, ngakho i-slope ka-y=−3x inkulu.
y-m-57-02.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 1 no-2 ngamaqiniso afundwe kugrafu. Umugqa 3, 'enyuka kakhulu inayo i-slope enkulu', ukujwayelekisa, futhi akubambi. Ukunyuka kuqhathanisa amanani aphelele ama-slope (3 no-2), kuyilapho usayizi we-slope, kuhlanganisa uphawu, uqhathanisa u-−3 no-2. Umugqa 4 umphumela nje wokusebenzisa umugqa 3, futhi ngomugqa 5, u-−3 ungakwesobunxele luka-2 emgqeni wezinombolo, ngakho −3<2.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imisebenzi ema-3 ehlukene emaqondana y=ax+b enyuka kakhulu kuno-y=2x kodwa ene-slope encane. I-y-intercept (b) kumele ibe ngu-1.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uphinde ubhale 'okunyuka kakhulu' usebenzisa inani eliphelele le-slope, bese uthola ibanga emgqeni wezinombolo eliyanelisa kanye no-'i-slope incane'.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.hint.1: Uma usukhethe ongaqokelwayo a, hlola izimo ezimbili ngokwehlukana.
y-m-57-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Inyuka kakhulu kuno-y=2x (inani eliphelele le-slope likhulu kuno-2).
y-m-57-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuze inyuke kakhulu, inani eliphelele le-slope kumele libe likhulu kuno-2, futhi i-slope kumele ibe incane kuno-2, ngakho a kumele ibe incane kuno-−2. Izibonelo: y=−3x+1, y=−5x+1, y=−2.5x+1. a=3 inayo i-slope enkulu nayo, ngakho akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.prompt: Manje bhala ngokwehlukana izimo lapho 'igrafu inyuka kakhulu' no-'i-slope inkulu' kusho into efanayo nezimo lapho kungenjalo.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukulandelana kokunyuka nokulandelana kwama-slope lapho zombili ama-slope ziyiphozithivu, njengo-2 no-5.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ngendlela efanayo icala lapho zombili ziyi-negethivu, njengo-−2 no-−5.
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole icala lapho kusho into efanayo ngama-slope amabili athile?
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uxhumanise elinye icala nesibonelo esiphikisayo owasenza ngaphambilini?
y-m-57-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange nangecala lapho i-slope ingu-0?
y-m-57-02.s.s3.model.0: Lapho zombili ama-slope eyiphozithivu, enyuka kakhulu nayo inayo i-slope enkulu. Kodwa lapho kuxutshwe i-negethivu, ukunyuka kuqhathaniswa ngenani eliphelele, ngakho kungahluka ekuqhathaniseni usayizi wama-slope.

y-m-57-04.title: Ukwazi ukuphakama kwe-ramp
y-m-57-04.topic: Izilinganiso ze-trigonometric: ukufana konxantathu abafanele nolwazi lobude
y-m-57-04.goal: Nquma ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwanele ukumisa ukuphakama konxantathu ofanele kube yinani elilodwa, bese uqinisekisa ngezibonelo ozakhayo wena ukuthi uma i-engeli ifana, izilinganiso zezinhlangothi ziyafana noma ubude buhlukile.
y-m-57-04.material: Ufuna ukubeka i-ramp eqondile kusukela emhlabathini ongenazimbibi uye ekungeneni kwesakhiwo.
